Amazon is now offering the lowest price anywhere on the new AirPods 5 with ANC pre-orders down at $125, just after launching its early fall Prime Day deals (details here). Those offers join the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal at $50 off and AirTag 2 at $20 each, but today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by a pair of M5 MacBook Air configs at $150 off via Amazon. We also have the first cash discounts on most affordable Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 with the new Translucent Ocean Band, joined by this discount on Anker’s iPhone 18 Pro-ready Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe Wireless Car Charger Mount. All of that and more awaits below.

Amazon officially announces massive fall Prime Day sale: Early deals now live

Amazon now offering the brand new AirPods 5 with ANC down at $125, AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 5 $125 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case $149
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)

Apple’s 1TB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air is $150 off at Amazon today (All colors)

Yesterday we spotted a few Midnight M5 MacBook Air configs on sale and today Amazon is offering all four colors of the mid-tier 13-inch model at $150 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage down at $1,449 shipped.

As of the time writing, all four colors are down at this price: Silver, Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue. This is actually the first time we have seen all four paint jobs in this mid-range configuration down this low over the last few months.

You’re looking at a regularly $1,599 machine with a solid $150 price drop. Today’s deal is matching the lowest price we have tracked on this configuration since the price increases in late June.

While the list prices on the M5 MacBook Air lineup have gone up, we are still talking about the best bang for you buck when it comes to Apple laptops in my opinion. And this is a solid mid-range option that comes in well below the $1,650 deal price on the most affordable 24GB machine Amazon sells (this one is $150 off in select colors right now though).

You will find some lighter deals on the 15-inch models right now, but these two 13-inchers are delivering the best value right now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (Reg. $1,799)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)

Most affordable M5 MacBook Air down at $1,099 again via Apple refurb if you’re fast ($200 off)

We are tracking a couple notable $150 price drops on mid-tier M5 MacBook Air configurations at Amazon in brand new condition this week. However, the official Apple refurb store just re-stocked the most affordable model down at $1,099 in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue if you’re quick.

The most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of internal storage sitting down at $1,099 shipped. We suspect, as per usual with this model coming straight from, Apple colors will begin to sell out quick: Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

And because it is coming straight from Apple, we are talking about the best refurbishment process there is with a proper warranty too:

  • Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Apple’s Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale

Regularly $1,299 these days, and rarely ever lower than $1,199 at Amazon these days, you can now land this model at $200 off straight from Apple.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

That said, if you’re looking to go new, there are a couple particularly notable price drops on Amazon today for the 13-inch model:

Amazon just lowered the pre-order price on most affordable Apple Watch Series 12

Amazon really wants your Apple Watch Series 12 pre-order, as it has already started to undercut everyone else ahead of release on select configurations. Alongside deals on some of the other options, this morning it dropped the price on the most affordable model you can buy.

Again, these early pre-order deals aren’t massive by any means, but they are pre-orders of the brand new Apple Watch that hasn’t even released yet and if you are going to be grabbing one you might as well save some coffee money.

Amazon is now offering the base 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 down at $389.99 shipped. This is the lowest price you’ll find anywhere ahead of delivery this Friday. Yes, that is only $10 or so, but it is the lowest price anywhere for the most affordable version of Apple’s new black Series 12.

Here’s a look at how pricing breaks down across the new lineup ahead of delivery day:

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm $390 (Reg. $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm $449
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm GPS + Cell $490 (Reg. $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm GPS + Cell $540 (Reg. $549)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Titanium$679 (Reg. $699)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Titanium$729 (Reg. $749)
    • With Natural Milanese Loop
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Titanium $729
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic$929 (Reg. $949)

First deal hits Apple Watch Ultra 4 with new Translucent Ocean Band

Amazon is looking to entice folks with some light pre-order deals on the newest Apple Watch releases ahead of the Friday delivery date, and if you’re going to be picking one up you might as well keep some cash in your pocket. Much like we are seeing on various Series 12 models, it is now undercutting everyone on the brand new Apple Ultra 4 with the sweet new Translucent Gray Ocean Band.

Amazon is now offering pre-orders for the new Apple Watch Ultra 4 with the Translucent Gray Ocean Band down at $779.99 shipped.

This is indeed a regularly $799 Ultra, much like the previous-generation, and certainly not a massive discount, but it is the lowest pre-order price we can find anywhere. Considering you’re getting the exact same thing with the same September 18 delivery date at Amazon as you would at Apple, there’s really no reason to pay more for it.

This year, Apple launched its series 4 Ultra with a series of fresh colorways for the Alpine and Trail Loops, as well as all-new Ocean Brand designs – the Translucent Gray we have featured above, as well as Translucent Kelp and Black variants:

  • NEW Trail Loop $99
    • Sand, Dark Umber, Burgundy
  • NEW Ocean Band $99
    • Translucent Kelp, Gray, and Black
  • NEW Alpine Loop $99
    • Desert, Dark Olive, and Burgundy

Next-gen 2026 Apple Polishing Cloth now available on Amazon at $9 Prime shipped, grab one before they sell out

M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts live at Amazon ahead of delivery this month

We are moving closer to delivery day on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro model. If you’re still considering a pre-order, scoop up the new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth before it sells out and check out the discounts Amazon is offering on Apple’s new Mac mini pre-orders.

We have already highlighted these deals in various posts as they went live, but we wanted to make sure they were all in one place and on the radar for folks still considering a pre-order ahead of this month’s delivery date:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (Reg. $1,699)

Anker’s iPhone 18 Pro-ready Prime 25W MagSafe Car Charger Mount is 25% off today

Amazon has already announced and delivered some early Prime Big Deal Days offers, and Anker is on the list. This week we are tracking deals on a series of its iPhone 18 Pro-ready accessories, including the 25W 3-in-1 Smart Display Charging Station and the 25W 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger, but the price has also now dropped on its Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe Wireless Car Charger Mount as well.

The brand’s official Amazon storefront is now offering its Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe Wireless Car Charger Mount down at $67.49 shipped. Regularly $90, this is a solid 25% price drop and the lowest price we can find on its latest 25W model.

The iPhone 18 Pro-ready charging mount is now sitting within less than $5 of the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon since release roughly this time last year.

New Magflow Pro 25W 3-in-1 Smart Display MagSafe Charger drops to $125 all-time low

Alongside a solid 40% price drop on Anker’s Smart Display 3-in-1 25W MagSafe charging station this morning, the official UGREEN Amazon store is now offering a new all-time low on its brand new 3-in-1 display-equipped model as well.

UGREEN’s official Amazon storefront is now offering its brand new Magflow Pro 25W Qi2.2-Certified 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station down at $124.99 shipped, alongside up to 30% off a number of its latest charging gear releases we featured at the top of the month.

The new Magflow Pro station carries a $160 list price and has been down at $130 for Prime members as part of its launch deal. Today, however, it has now dropped a touch lower to deliver a new all-time low.

While there are a few 3-in-1 Qi2.2 models out there nowadays delivering unique designs, they are still plenty of them following the same blueprint with a Qi pad on the base and a pair extensions holding the 25W MagSafe pad and so forth. The new Magflow Pro switches things up with a single arm that carries the 25W MagSafe pad, complete with TEC Active Cooling and a smart display for

  • Anker 10-in-1 Outlet Extender with USB-C drops to $16 Prime shipped
  • Upgrade your kitchen with Govee’s stylishly sleek Smart Electric Gooseneck Kettle while down at a $56 2026 low
  • Anker’s new Apple Home-ready solar-charging Wall Light Cam S4 tries to do it all [Launch deal]
  • Last day to score Anker’s 100W Smart Display Charger at 30% off via Amazon
  • Anker’s 25W 3-in-1 Smart Display Charging Station is iPhone 18 Pro-ready and 40% off today
  • Anker’s 25W 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger back to Amazon all-time low at 35% off

All-time low pricing returns on AirTag 2 today at $20 each

Pre-orders are flying on the new AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12 (Amazon already has some deals too), but the AirTag 2 deals are back again today as well. After jumping back up close to full price over the last couple days, Amazon has decided to bring back all-time low pricing on Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 at $20 each.

The single AirTag 2 listing has remained down at $24 Prime shipped for a few weeks now – this is matching the lowest price we have tracked for one of them in new condition at Amazon.

The 4-pack, however, is now sitting back down at $79.99 shipped– that’s $20 per AirTag 2.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

You’re looking at a return of the best price ever for the 4-pack and the lowest per-Tag price we have tracked to date. This is the same deal that landed for the first time at the end of August as part of the Labor Day festivities at Amazon and, after jumping back up to full price a few times since, is now live once again.

AirTag 2 features better security and privacy features, a 50% louder speaker, and upgraded Ultra Wideband and Bluetooth chips for better range. At $20 a pop, it is a wonderful way to update your Apple tracker fleet, or land some sweet Apple gifts for some folks.

More of this week’s best Apple deals:

Most affordable current-gen iPad Air now $100 off at Amazon

While this week it’s all about iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12, we are catching a relatively rare chance to score the most affordable current-generation iPad Air at $100 off.

Amazon is now offering the 128GB 11-inch M4 iPad Air in a couple different colors down at $649 shipped. Regularly $749, this is $100 off and the lowest price can find.

You’ll also find the 256GB 11-inch model in Gray down at $749.99 shipped on Amazon – this is just shy of $100 off and also the best deal we can find right now.

Both storage capacity options are, more or less, at the lowest prices we have tracked since the price increases back in late June. The 128GB gray model has dropped down a touch lower than this, but only for extremely short periods of time – you have had to be incredibly lucky and fast to score one for any lower than this since July.

As mentioned above, most eyes in the Apple world are zeroed in on the new iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods 5 right now. We have detailed some chances at savings on all of them now, and you’ll find the details below alongside some additional Apple discounts:

  • AirPods 5 $129
  • iPhone 18 Pro from $32 per month | AT&T
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max from $34 per month | AT&T
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max from $34 per month | Verizon
  • iPhone 18 Pro $12 per month + $867 down | T-Mobile
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max $32 per month + $937 down | T-Mobile

iPhone 18 Pro pre-order deals: Options from $867, under $12 per month, more

The iPhone 18 Pro is going up for pre-order this morning. Just after AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12 went live live alongside the ongoing discount on AirPods Pro 3, you will be able to secure Apple’s latest and greatest iPhone 18 Pro is starting from $32 per month on major carriers or $1,199 all-in unlocked. However, Walmart is also featuring some options for much less than that via T-Mobile starting at $867 + $11.85 per month on iPhone 18 Pro.

You’ll want to head straight to Apple if you’re taking the unlocked or trade-in route of course, but there are some other options out there this morning. More details below.
